run_sample_questions_for_manual_review: run the script to extract sampled questions from a HITs JSON file into a formatted text file for manual review
run_export_questions_by_house: run the script to export questions grouped by house ID from a JSON file to a text output file
run_convert_hits_json_to_text: run the script to convert a HITs JSON file containing sampled questions into a readable text format
review_question_sampling_output: review the text output file generated from sampled HITs questions to verify question and answer pairs
refactor_sample_for_manual_view: refactor the script to support additional spatial preposition templates beyond the default ten
